Mattermost.note: Brand name; never translate or decline. Keep uninflected in all cases (do Mattermost, w Mattermost).

Enterprise Edition.note: Product edition name; keep in English. Existing pl.json once mistranslates it as 'Edytuj Zespół' (Team Edition) — do not follow that.

Team Edition.note: Product edition name; keep in English.

Channels.note: Product name; keep in English. The common noun 'channel' is translated as 'kanał'.

Calls.note: Product name; keep in English. The common noun 'call' is translated as 'połączenie'.

MFA.note: Spelled-out form is 'uwierzytelnianie wieloskładnikowe' in existing translations.

System Console.note: Established rendering across webapp/server/mobile. Locative: 'w Konsoli systemowej'. Existing usage varies in capitalization ('konsola systemowa' mid-sentence is fine).

marketplace.note: Existing usage is inconsistent: 'sklep z wtyczkami' (webapp admin), plain 'Sklep' (server /marketplace command), and untranslated 'Marketplace'. Prefer 'sklep z wtyczkami'; when referring to the proper name in admin settings, 'Marketplace' may be kept.

channel.note: Masculine. Plural 'kanały'; locative 'w kanale/na kanale' (both occur; 'w kanale' is slightly more common and preferred).

post.note: Majority rendering is the loanword 'post' (masculine; plural 'posty'). 'wpis' appears sporadically — avoid it for consistency.

direct message.note: Established rendering; plural 'wiadomości bezpośrednie'. Do not translate the DM abbreviation.

pin.note: Imperative button 'Przypnij'. 'Pinned messages' → 'Przypięte wiadomości'; 'unpin' → 'odepnij'. One legacy webapp string uses 'pinezki' — avoid.

bookmark.note: Noun: 'zakładka' (feminine). Verb: 'dodaj zakładkę'. Channel bookmark → 'zakładka kanału'.

draft.note: Existing usage is split between 'wersja robocza' and 'szkic'; 'wersja robocza' is the majority in user-facing strings and matches Polish UI convention. Plural 'wersje robocze'.

emoji.note: Indeclinable neuter loanword; same form in singular and plural ('to emoji', 'te emoji').

custom status.note: Word order varies in existing strings ('niestandardowy status' also common); both acceptable, prefer 'status niestandardowy' for labels.

do not disturb.note: Established status name. Keep 'tryb „Nie przeszkadzać”' when used as a noun phrase. Do not translate the DND abbreviation.

away.note: Established status name (lit. 'be right back'), consistent across webapp and mobile. Avoid 'nieobecny', which appears in a few legacy server strings.

online.note: Majority keeps the loanword 'online' (indeclinable). Mobile occasionally uses 'Dostępny' — prefer 'Online' for the status name.

offline.note: Majority keeps 'offline' (indeclinable). 'Niedostępny' appears in some server command strings.

guest.note: Masculine. Plural 'goście'; genitive plural 'gości'. 'Guest access' → 'dostęp dla gości'.

member.note: Masculine personal. Plural 'członkowie'; genitive 'członka'. 'channel member' → 'członek kanału'.

system admin.note: Plural 'administratorzy systemu'. Use consistently for 'System Administrator' too.

sign in.note: Button 'Zaloguj się'. Translate 'log in' and 'sign in' identically.

sign out.note: Button 'Wyloguj się'. Translate 'log out' and 'sign out' identically.

unarchive.note: Existing renderings are inconsistent ('Odarchiwizuj', 'Zdearchiwizuj', 'Cofnij archiwizację'); none has a clear majority. Prefer the standard 'cofnij archiwizację' (button 'Cofnij archiwizację') and avoid the non-standard coinages.

mute.note: Button 'Wycisz'; 'muted' → 'wyciszony'; 'unmute' → 'wyłącz wyciszenie'. Same verb is used for Calls microphone muting.

follow.note: Button 'Obserwuj'. Majority rendering; 'śledzić' appears in some thread-related strings — prefer 'obserwować' for consistency with webapp and Playbooks.

unfollow.note: Button 'Przestań obserwować' (mobile/playbooks) or 'Nie obserwuj' (webapp menu items).

favorite.note: Adjective/noun 'ulubiony'; sidebar category 'Ulubione'; verb → 'dodaj do ulubionych', 'unfavorite' → 'usuń z ulubionych'.

slash command.note: Majority rendering (mobile, playbooks, newer webapp). Older strings use 'komenda po ukośniku' — prefer 'polecenie'.

webhook.note: Kept in English by convention; declined as masculine ('webhooka', 'webhooki', 'webhookami').

incoming webhook.note: Word order varies in existing strings ('przychodzący webhook' also common); prefer noun-first 'webhook przychodzący' for term consistency with 'webhook wychodzący'.

trigger word.note: Existing usage mixes 'słowo wyzwalające' and 'słowo wyzwalacza'; prefer 'słowo wyzwalające'.

plugin.note: Feminine. Plural 'wtyczki'. Avoid the loanword 'plugin' seen in a few legacy strings.

permission.note: Neuter. Plural 'uprawnienia'. Majority rendering; avoid 'pozwolenie' seen sporadically.

seat.note: Licensed seat → 'miejsce' (plural 'miejsca', genitive plural 'miejsc'). 'stanowisko' appears once — avoid.

trial.note: For the time period use 'okres próbny'; for a trial license use 'licencja próbna'. Avoid 'wersja testowa' seen in some strings.

workspace.note: Majority rendering; 'przestrzeń robocza' also occurs — prefer 'obszar roboczy'. Locative 'w obszarze roboczym'.

subscription.note: Majority rendering; 'abonament' appears once in billing — prefer 'subskrypcja'.

unread.note: Adjective; agrees in gender/number ('nieprzeczytana wiadomość', 'nieprzeczytane kanały'). Category label 'Unreads' → 'Nieprzeczytane'.

shared channel.note: Majority rendering; 'kanał współdzielony' appears in some server strings — prefer 'udostępniony'.

persistent notification.note: Majority rendering; 'powiadomienie stałe' also occurs — prefer 'trwałe powiadomienie'.

urgent.note: Label 'PILNE' when uppercased. Agrees with 'wiadomość': 'pilna wiadomość', 'pilna wzmianka'.

recap.note: Established rendering in webapp/server AI strings. Plural 'podsumowania'.

agent.note: AI assistant. Masculine personal: plural 'agenci' (nominative), 'agentów' (genitive/accusative). 'AI agents' → 'agenci AI'.

burn-on-read.note: Existing translations mostly keep the English term ('wiadomość burn-on-read', 'post burn-on-read'); occasional literal renderings ('do zniszczenia przy odczycie') are inconsistent. Keep English and treat as indeclinable attribute.

magic link.note: Majority rendering; a few strings keep English 'magic link' — prefer 'magiczny link'. Genitive 'magicznego linku'.

announcement banner.note: Existing renderings vary ('baner ogłoszenia', 'baner ogłoszeniowy'); prefer 'baner ogłoszeń'.

user group.note: Plain 'group' in this sense is also 'grupa'.

permalink.note: Kept as loanword in existing translations; declined as masculine ('permalinku'). A more descriptive alternative would be 'link bezpośredni', but stay with 'permalink' for consistency.

collapsed reply threads.note: Only existing rendering (mobile settings) is 'Zawijanie Odpowiedzi w Wątkach'. A more literal alternative is 'zwinięte wątki odpowiedzi', but keep the established form for consistency.

data retention.note: Majority rendering in webapp; 'retencja danych' appears in server enterprise strings. Prefer 'przechowywanie danych'; policy → 'zasady przechowywania danych'.

access control.note: 'attribute-based access control' → 'kontrola dostępu oparta na atrybutach'; policy → 'polityka kontroli dostępu'.

attribute.note: Masculine. Plural 'atrybuty'. 'custom profile attribute' → 'niestandardowy atrybut profilu' / 'atrybut użytkownika'.

onboarding.note: Existing translations mostly keep the loanword 'onboarding'; 'proces wprowadzania' appears descriptively. Keep 'onboarding' (masculine, declinable: 'onboardingu').

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server translations; translate consistently as a channel name.

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in server translations.

read-only.note: Avoid hyphenated 'tylko-do-odczytu' seen in a few legacy strings; standard Polish is unhyphenated.
